page.title: Getting started
page.description: Three steps to make the system work: locations, platforms, team

noPermission: This step is done by an organisation administrator

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Upload the list of branches from a file or add them by hand
locations.have: {count, plural, one {# location added} other {# locations added}}
locations.hint: A CSV or XLSX with «Name», «Address», «Phone» columns works. A template can be downloaded on the import screen.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Connect Yandex, Google and 2GIS accounts — the system will find your listings and reviews
platforms.hint: Platforms can be connected later in «Settings → Platform accounts»

team.title: Team
team.description: Invite colleagues who will reply to reviews and look after the listings
team.have: {count, plural, one {# colleague on the team} other {# colleagues on the team}}
team.none: You are alone in the organisation so far
team.hint: Roles and location access can be changed later in «Users»
